# lifesim-22b3: UMA overlay colour clamps at 1: light skin tones render as the raw texture
bug · P3 · auto, lane:creator

## Description
## Goal
The three lightest skin palette tones render distinct and close to their palette colour.
## Context
UmaCharacter.UnderTexture (client/Assets/Views/Character/UmaCharacter.cs:396) divides the palette shade by the skin texture average; for the 3 lightest tones the result exceeds 1 and UMA's colour multiply clamps, so Unity renders all three identically (176,139,124 on the cheek patch). Godot (tint unclamped) reaches 234,207,192 for tone 0. Data: prototype/uma-godot-spikes/w1-3/results/w13-deltae.csv on branch claude/godot-engine-reconsider-491ecc (not on main). Fix by offset/additive colour or colour transfer instead of multiply.
## Done when
- A test computes the cheek-patch colour for tones 0-2 (render or the colour maths) and asserts they differ and each is within deltaE 2000 of 6 from its palette colour
- Portrait sheet via tools/look_portraits.sh, reviewed with client/LOOK_REVIEW.md loop, attached to the bead
- Darker tones unchanged (deltaE < 2 vs before)
- just check green (close the editor first); grep the Unity logs for exception|error per client/AGENTS.md
## Touches
client/Assets/Views/Character/UmaCharacter.cs, client/Assets/Tests/Editor/
## Out of scope
Changing the palette in content
